attackers_goals: Execute malicious content on and move laterally across machine in the network.
description: An attacker is using the DSC feature with PowerShell to remotely modify / execute content / components on the machine.
investigative_actions: Search for suspicious WinRM sessions and the user created them, can be found at Event ID: 4102. Additionally, search for the DSC resource executed and related IOC, can be found at Event IDs: 400 or 4104.
name: DSC (Desired State Configuration) lateral movement using PowerShell
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)

variations.name: DSC (Desired State Configuration) lateral movement using PowerShell to execute a script
variations.description: An attacker may use the DSC feature with PowerShell to execute script remotely on a machine.
variations.attackers_goals: Execute malicious content on and move laterally across machine in the network.
variations.investigative_actions: Search for suspicious WinRM sessions and the user created them, can be found at Event ID: 4102. Additionally, search for the DSC resource executed and related IOC, can be found at Event IDs: 400 or 4104. The executed script is logged under Event ID 4104.

variations.name: DSC (Desired State Configuration) lateral movement using PowerShell to execute a new service
variations.description: An attacker may use the DSC feature with PowerShell to create and execute a service on the host.
variations.attackers_goals: Execute malicious content on and move laterally across machine in the network.
variations.investigative_actions: Search for suspicious WinRM sessions and the user created them, can be found at Event ID: 4102. Additionally, search for the DSC resource executed and related IOC, can be found at Event IDs: 400 or 4104.

variations.name: DSC (Desired State Configuration) lateral movement using PowerShell to modify the registry
variations.description: An attacker may use the DSC feature with PowerShell to create/modify/dump registry keys/values.
